messages:
Anna (Partnerships): Quick sync 6; we're coordinating Aurora region onboarding with KubeBerry as the SI. Need cloud quotas, marketplace entitlements, and legal signoff ahead of the embargo.
Devon (Marketplace): OK. Entitlement package needs SKU manifest, estimated QPS, and a fallback policy. Who can provide numbers?
Suresh (PartnerEng): Initial footprint: equivalent to 8 A100s, 3 always-on inference nodes, burst to 16 GPUs. Expected ~120 reqs/min, target p95 latency 150ms.
Joel (CloudOps): I'll open the cloud quota request. Do you have the exact SKU IDs and KMS alias we should include for the marketplace integration?
Suresh (PartnerEng): SKUs: kb-infer-a100, kb-gpu-burst, kb-private-vpc. KMS alias: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/aurora/cryptoKeys/kubeberry-launch
Marta (Legal): Heads-up: legal needs the joint press text + the private deployment dataflow diagram. Please drop into Drive so I can triage.
Liam (SI, KubeBerry): We'll need a short ops runbook snippet for automatic failover to the quantized model family if capacity hits limits. Can Redwood share an example auto-fallback config?
Devon (Marketplace): Example policy (use in entitlement request):
```
fallback_policy:
  - when_cpu>80%: route_to: kb-quantized-micro
  - when_latency>250ms: scale_out: +2 nodes
  - auth: marketplace-tier:dedicated
```
Anna (Partnerships): Timeline: embargo lift Tue 2024-06-18 10:00 PDT. So quotas + entitlements need to be provisioned and smoke-tested by Mon EOD.
Joel (CloudOps): Filing ticket now: https://cloud.example.com/quotas/REQ-77421 (asked for expedite). Typical approval 48h but will ping partner ops.
marketplace-bot: Entitlement created: ENT-202406-aurora. Required docs: SKU manifest, KMS access proof, SI runbook, legal signoff.
Liam (SI, KubeBerry): We'll run failover tests in KubeBerry staging on Thu. Need staging API keys and marketplace sandbox access.
Devon (Marketplace): I'll generate staging keys: scope=staging, expires=2024-06-20. Send me emails for the test accounts.
Suresh (PartnerEng): Shared runbook + dataflow here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/aurora-onboard-runbook. Added a README and test checklist.
Marta (Legal): Received. I'll start review once the README includes the customer PII handling section. Please ensure the Drive doc has the redact table.
Joel (CloudOps): Quota ticket updated with SKU list and KMS alias. Also requested quota increase for burst pool. Ticket link posted in thread.
Anna (Partnerships): @press-ops please hold public comms until we confirm everything. Do not schedule the press release until I confirm.
press-ops: Copy that . We'll hold the agency brief until final signoff.
Devon (Marketplace): Action items summarized: Suresh - final SKU manifest + Drive edits; Joel - expedite quota ticket and confirm cloud provider SLA conditions; Marta - legal review; Liam - staging failover test; I'll produce entitlement request and issue staging keys.
Anna (Partnerships): Thanks everyone. Update in thread when each task closes. :thumbsup:
